title: Surgical Media Beat Script
description: Input for scripts/tts_align.py: narration beats to be voiced and locked to frame-accurate timing.

subject.description: The video's subject (e.g. 'emperor penguin'). Used to match licensed manifest imagery to scenes when a scene has no visual.query.

voices.description: Optional per-scene voice map (scene_id → voice). tts_align: CLI --voice > script.voice > per-scene override > default

visual.description: Per-scene art direction. Default image-first: tts_align wires a licensed subject plate from --assets-manifest. kind=svg/3d/procedural opts out; visual.image pins an explicit plate.

image.description: Explicit asset path (relative to the script file or absolute).

query.description: Subject query used to match manifest assets (and to drive fetch_assets.py).

attribution.description: Credit line for an explicit image that is not in the assets manifest.
